nodes.name: 01 Catch lead failure
nodes.notes: Select this workflow as V3 main Error workflow. No API key or helper workflow needed.

nodes.name: 02 Prepare safe failure
nodes.notes: Reuse V2 error scrubber, plus email masking. Only reason, node, execution ID and timestamp. No lead body, company response, credential, stack or arbitrary URL.

nodes.name: 03 Record failure on lead
nodes.notes: Only rows owned by the failed execution and still new/processing may be marked failed. A missing row or logging failure still continues to the admin alert. No new table, expiry or automatic write retry.

nodes.name: 04 Alert lead errors

parameters.text:
={{ (()=>{const r=$('02 Prepare safe failure').first().json;const esc=s=>String(s).replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>');return 'NovaCore V3 failure | <@<YOUR_SLACK_OWNER_ID>>
Node: '+esc(r.node)+'
Reason: '+esc(r.message)+'
Execution: '+esc(r.execution_id);})() }}

nodes.notes: Safe internal metadata only. Attach NovaCore Slack; <YOUR_SLACK_CHANNEL_ID> must include this bot. Alert failure is visible in n8n; do not automatically retry notifications.
